name: Kabuk — WMS ve Mobile POS sekmeleri görünmez
description: Demo Market girişi sonrası üst kabukta WMS ve Mobile POS / mobil POS sekmeleri görünmemelidir.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Market (001), enter the app shell
Verify the top module shell shows allowed modules such as Market POS and Yönetim, and does NOT show any tab or icon labeled WMS, Depo WMS, Mobile POS, or Mobil POS
